source_preparation_boundary.eligibility: at least 128 valid tokens including BOS; exact fit/validation/P04 opaque exclusion audit required before freeze
source_preparation_boundary.selection_inputs: public dataset metadata and opaque digest ledgers only; no predictions, correctness, target labels, or private weights
source_preparation_boundary.fresh_ranges: not selected; root/design must freeze ranges and ledger version before candidate enumeration
source_preparation_boundary.plaintext_boundary: source rows/token values remain evaluator-side and are never placed in student registration, messages, or published setup metadata

stages.pairing: identical source-record order and masks for public_base/public_lora_2601; target condition is metadata only until public capture

inputs: frozen panel source rows held evaluator-side
outputs: one observation index per target cell
stages.truth_boundary: capture writes no source text, token IDs, target labels, correctness, or evaluator truth into observation artifacts
stages.qualification: qualify fixed batch-8 x 192 full forward with active masks; retain only H128 after validating geometry and mask/position identity

inputs: frozen arm masks and pinned direct affine descriptor
stages.student_boundary: fresh panel observations only; no source rows, target labels, correctness feedback, A2, or guessed-token feedback

stages.truth_action: only after joint freeze review may evaluator materialize fresh truth once and compute declared metrics

artifact_contract.private_evaluator_source: task-local runtime only; path/hash published only after review, source content excluded
